cohort: Pregnant women at term undergoing either elective caesarean or amnioreduction (n=13 for amniotic fluid) and newborns from a separate clinical trial (n=15 for cord blood).
finding: This study provides the first evidence of in utero NNS exposure in humans, detecting acesulfame-potassium, saccharin, and steviol glucuronide in amniotic fluid, and acesulfame-potassium and saccharin in umbilical cord blood.
